A data row with more cells than the header widens the separator so no cell is silently dropped

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<table><tr><th>A</th><th>B</th></tr><tr><td>1</td><td>2</td><td>3</td></tr></table>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
